key.name: reserve-space
key.summary: Keep the top bar's strip of screen reserved
key.description: Off, the default: the bar's strut is dropped, so a maximized window gets the full height of the screen and covers the bar. On: windows still stop below the bar as they do in stock GNOME, and the bar only goes behind a window when "yield-to-above" lets it.

key.name: yield-to-above
key.summary: Let Always-on-Top windows pass over the bar
key.description: Only has an effect while reserve-space is on. GNOME's own "Always on Top" still loses to the shell's own chrome; this makes the bar drop behind such a window while it overlaps the bar, and come back when it does not. Windows that cannot reach the bar's strip -- anything the work area constrains -- are unaffected either way.

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log every raise/lower decision to the journal
key.description: Takes effect immediately, no reload. Read it with journalctl --user -f -o cat | grep underbar
